system.description: You know your way around patches and love collecting them. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you are able to identify a patch and its bonus level, if any.

upgrades.description: You can sew and iron patches onto clothing using this Skill.
You may use this as a crafting Skill, but crafting tables provide no bonuses. Enchanted patches are limited to one per Gear slot and do not take up Accessory slots.
Your crafting Checks take half the time. Increase the bonus value of your enchantments with this Skill by 1, at no additional Difficulty or time to craft.

system.limitations: This Limited Skill can only be learned via a Race, Class, or item.
